 By Shaghil Bilali , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 03, 2026, 10:48:31 AM IST Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis
 The launch of the EPFO WhatsApp service was announced by Union Minister Mansukh Mandaviya. This new feature empowers subscribers to easily check their EPF balance, view the latest transactions, and download passbook details. Moreover, the initiative addresses automatic settlements for dormant accounts, benefiting around one lakh users whose balance falls under Rs 1,000, thereby simplifying processes and minimizing the necessity for in-person visits.  Listen ET Online EPFO's WhatsApp service Celebrating the 74th Foundation Day of the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation ( EPF O), Union Minister Mansukh Mandaviya, who is also the chairman of the Central Board of Trustees (EPF), has announced the launch of two key services for EPFO subscribers: the EPFO WhatsApp service and the automatic settlement of eligible inoperative EPF accounts .
 What is the EPFO’s WhatsApp service ? 
Mandaviya announced that EPF subscribers will be able to access their Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) balance, latest five transactions and passbook information through the EPFO's verified WhatsApp service. 
Mandaviya says the WhatsApp service will also provide personalised guidance and assistance in completing PMVBRY-related requirements.
“This will make routine services accessible through a familiar mobile platform and reduce the need to visit EPFO offices,” says Mandaviya.
Also Read: 8th Pay Commission: 6 key demands by Railway employee's body; better pay, merging of pay scales, hardship allowance and more 
 How can EPFO subscribers avail its WhatsApp service ? 
In a social media post, the EPFO says that subscribers can scan a QR code given in its social media message. Once downloaded, subscribers can also select their preferred language for sending messages.
These subscribers can start by writing "Hi" and sending it to 8796441800. Once the message is sent, subscribers can avail the following services-
 Check EPF balance 
 See last 5 EPF transactions
 Download EPF passbook 
 Launch of automatic settlement of eligible inoperative EPF accounts 
Mandaviya also launched a service where subscribers having Aadhaar-verified inoperative EPF accounts with balances up to Rs 1,000 will not be required to file individual claims. The EPFO will initiate settlement automatically after prescribed identity and bank-account verification, facilitating the transfer of eligible dues to rightful beneficiaries.
Also Read: IDBI Bank strike on November 2 and 3, 2026: Bank advises customers to use digital channels; removes fee on non-IDBI ATM withdrawals 
The Minister says that approximately one lakh accounts involving Rs 5 crore are expected to benefit from the scheme.
 A significant improvement in claim settlement was highlighted, with the average settlement time declining to 2.57 days in October 2026, the Minister highlighted.
 What is an inoperative EPF account? 
An account is classified as an inoperative account in which contributions have not been received for 3 years after retirement or permanent migration abroad or in case of death.
 Will your inoperative EPF account earn interest? 
No. However, at present, all accounts will earn interest up to 58 years age of a member.
Also Read: Bank of India revises FD interest rates: Launches 500-day fixed deposit offering 7.35% rate to senior citizens 
 What should you do if your EPF account becomes inoperative? 
If you are still working in an establishment covered under the EPF & MP Act, 1952, you can get the amount transferred into your new EPF account either online or offline. If you have retired, you may withdraw the EPF amount. ( Originally published on Nov 02, 2026 ) (Join our ETWealth WhatsApp channel for all the latest updates)
